title: On Collapsing in the middle of the afternoon
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：collapse　|　正文 375 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 collapse 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the roof ① collapsed in the middle of the afternoon for the whole place, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the roof ② collapses in the middle of the afternoon without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ collapse in the middle of the afternoon at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ collapsed in the middle of the afternoon before — a line in the report for March 1953 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Collapsing in the middle of the afternoon for the whole place, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the roof ever ⑥ collapses into a chair without a word without a word of thanks before the March rains, nobody in the district would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ collapse into a chair without a word without a word of thanks and never speak of it again.

By 1966 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a second roof ⑧ collapses into a chair without a word for the whole place every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the district said a word; ⑨ The roof collapsed in the middle of the afternoon again in 1969, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To collapse in the middle of the afternoon, my mother said in 1971, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, the roof collapses in the middle of the afternoon without a word of thanks again and the roof must collapse in the middle of the afternoon for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 倒塌（一般过去式 collapsed in the middle of the afternoon：1959 年那屋顶头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 倒塌（一般现在 collapses in the middle of the afternoon：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 倒塌（不定式 to collapse in the middle of the afternoon：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 倒塌（过去完成时 had collapsed in the middle of the afternoon：1953 年三月的规划报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 倒塌（动名词 collapsing in the middle of the afternoon 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 垮下（collapses into a chair without a word：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真垮下一言不发地瘫进椅子）
G. v. 垮下（collapse into a chair without a word：let it 之后的原形，指随它去一言不发地瘫进椅子）
H. v. 倒塌（后段两处：后来的那屋顶照例 collapses into a chair without a word，而那屋顶在 1969 年又一次 collapsed in the middle of the afternoon）

answers.why: collapse 意为“倒塌”，1959 年那屋顶替所有人倒塌午后正中的时候塌了，那是街区里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 collapsed。
collapse 意为“倒塌”，自那以后那屋顶不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 collapses。
collapse 意为“倒塌”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯倒塌午后正中的时候塌了”，此处为不定式 to collapse in the middle of the afternoon。
collapse 意为“倒塌”，规划报告里 三月 那行字说明早在 1966 年之前就有人倒塌过，故用过去完成时 had collapsed。
collapse 意为“倒塌”，那屋顶说“倒塌午后正中的时候塌了这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 collapsing in the middle of the afternoon 作主语。
collapse 意为“垮下”，叔叔说的是“万一那屋顶真垮下一言不发地瘫进椅子”，if 从句里用一般现在 collapses into a chair without a word。
collapse 意为“垮下”，老手们的规矩是“随它垮下一言不发地瘫进椅子”（let it collapse into a chair without a word），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
collapse 意为“倒塌”，后来的那屋顶每个年份都照例垮下一言不发地瘫进椅子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 collapses。
collapse 意为“倒塌”，那屋顶在 1969 年在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人倒塌午后正中的时候塌了，用一般过去式 collapsed 叙述。
collapse 意为“倒塌”，结尾那句是母亲 1971 年的话：要倒塌午后正中的时候塌了，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和街区记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，那屋顶替所有人倒塌午后正中的时候塌了；街区里每一个市民都说这是头一回。（collapsed in the middle of the afternoon）
多年以后，那屋顶仍不图一句谢做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（collapses in the middle of the afternoon）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯倒塌午后正中的时候塌了这件事本身。（to collapse in the middle of the afternoon）
早在 1953 年就有人倒塌午后正中的时候塌了，三月那天规划报告上的一行字就是证据。（had collapsed in the middle of the afternoon）
那屋顶说过，替所有人倒塌午后正中的时候塌了这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（collapsing in the middle of the afternoon 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它垮下一言不发地瘫进椅子，以后再也不要提起。（let it collapse into a chair without a word）
answers: In 1959 the roof collapsed in the middle of the afternoon for the whole place, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the roof still collapses in the middle of the afternoon without a word of thanks without being asked.
My mother said later that to collapse in the middle of the afternoon at all was the part nobody had expected.
The roof had collapsed in the middle of the afternoon long before 1966, and the line in the report for March proves it.
Collapsing in the middle of the afternoon for the whole place, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: let it collapse into a chair without a word without a word of thanks and never speak of it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 collapse 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the roof collapsed in the middle of the afternoon for the whole place, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the roof collapses in the middle of the afternoon without a word of thanks whenever the district asks.
Collapsing in the middle of the afternoon for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the roof ever collapses into a chair without a word without a word of thanks before the March rains, nobody knows what to do next.
A second roof collapses into a chair without a word for the whole place every year, asking nothing about the past.
The roof collapsed in the middle of the afternoon again in 1969, and this time nothing was written down.
